segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to confirm the final scope before I send the order form over. I have 48 standard seats, 6 admin seats, and the reporting add-on for the operations team. Is that still right?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That's right. We may add three more standard seats in Q2, but for the initial contract, keep it at 48 and 6. Finance asked me not to pad it upfront.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Totally fair. The pricing sheet has standard seats at $62 per user per month and admin seats at $95. With the reporting add-on, the annual total comes to $43,704 before tax. I can put the expansion language in so additional seats co-term at the same rate.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that matches what you sent Friday. On billing, we need annual invoicing, net 30, and the PO number has to show on the invoice. The PO should be ready by March 18.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. I'll note annual billing, net 30, PO required. If the PO lands March 18, we can set the contract start date as April 1. Are you still targeting May 6 for go-live?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, May 6 is the target. We need implementation to start the week of April 8, though. Our data export from the old system is scheduled for April 10.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That works. I'll have services reserve the April 8 kickoff slot. The implementation package included is 18 hours, and based on what we reviewed, that should cover setup, one data import, and two admin training sessions.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. Legal only had one note on the renewal language. They want 60 days' notice instead of 90 for non-renewal. Is that going to be an issue?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: No, that one's standard enough. I'll route it through deal desk, but I don't expect pushback. I'll send the updated order form and terms this afternoon, and once signed, billing can generate the invoice against the PO.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Send it to me and copy Marcus in finance. If everything lines up, we should be able to sign by March 22.
